title: Answer to Question: On the Complicity of the Pakistani Regime in the Assassination of Bin Laden
text:
Answer to Question: On the Complicity of the Pakistani Regime in the Assassination of Bin Laden

Question:

The reports about the criminal assassination operation against Bin Laden have been contradictory, whether in the American statements or in the Pakistani statements... Some of these statements indicate that this operation took place with the knowledge of the Pakistani regime and with its cooperation, and some of them deny that wholly or partly...

We ask you to explain the view on this matter, and if it took place with cooperation, does that mean that the zero hour of the operation was set in consultation with the regime in Pakistan? May Allah reward you with good.

Answer:

There are strong indications that the operation took place with the knowledge of the Pakistani regime and its cooperation, in terms of supplying the American agencies with the intelligence information necessary to carry out the operation...

Among these indications:

1- The holding of an extraordinary meeting between General Petraeus, the commander of ISAF, and General Kayani at Chaklala air base on 25 April 2011, and General Petraeus held, on the same night, a closed session by telephone with the White House, chaired by President Barack Obama.

On the following day, the highest body for Pakistani military coordination held a meeting attended by the head of Pakistani intelligence, General Shuja Pasha, who is not a member of the Joint Chiefs of Staff. The meeting had not been scheduled beforehand.

Barack Obama alluded to the said telephone call when he announced the killing of Osama bin Laden, as he said: "And finally, last week, I determined that we had enough intelligence to take action, and authorized an operation to get Osama bin Laden and bring him to justice."

(Source: http://www.dawn.com/2011/05/03/pak-military-caught-in-the-crossfire.html )

2- Likewise, it was announced that Osama bin Laden was residing in the city of Bilal, which lies in an army area and beside the Pakistani Military Academy, which is surrounded by military checkpoints.

3- The statement of Zardari, which he made in the context of denying participation in the operation, yet he admitted that joint cooperation is what facilitated the assassination operation. Zardari said in the Washington Post newspaper: "Although the events of Sunday were not a joint operation, a decade of cooperation and partnership between the United States and Pakistan led up to the elimination of Osama bin Laden as a continuing threat to the civilized world."

4- The statement of Obama, who likewise tried to keep the Pakistani regime away from involvement in participating in the assassination, yet Obama admitted that cooperation with Pakistan is what helped to learn the location of Bin Laden. Obama said: "It's important to note that our counterterrorism cooperation with Pakistan helped lead us to bin Laden and the compound where he was hiding."

5- The previous incidents regarding the arrest of a number of al-Qaeda men such as Abu Faraj al-Libi, Khalid Sheikh Mohammed and Ahmed Khalfan Ghailani: they were arrested in similar areas, in areas close to luxurious military installations or in a secure environment, and they were handed over to America...

Accordingly, the Pakistani regime is drowning up to its ears in the crime of assassination. However, it is not necessarily the case that the zero hour which America set for the assassination took place with the knowledge of the Pakistani regime. Rather, the role of the Pakistani regime is the role of the spy who provides the information necessary to kill the victim and gives it to his master, so that he sets the zero hour, whether he informs the spy of it or does not inform him, for the spy is too lowly in his eyes for that!

Finally, we draw the attention of the people of Pakistan in general, and the Pakistani army in particular, to the fact that the survival of this regime is the root of the disease and the source of the affliction in Pakistan, and that it will not stop at complicity in the assassination of Bin Laden, may Allah have mercy on him and grant him dwelling in the spaciousness of His Gardens; rather, it will continue lapping at the blood of the Muslims... And that the Sharia obligation is to remove it and to establish the Khilafah in its place, so that Islam and the Muslims are honoured, and Kufr and the Kafirs are humiliated. "And Allah has full power and control over His affair, but most of mankind know not."
